// diagnostic

E0080

This named function body follows an arrow instead of braces.

What

This named function body follows an arrow instead of braces.

Why

A named function has one arrow, `->` or `-[Effects]>`, followed by its optional return type; the body always sits in braces: `fn name(...) -> Type { … }`.

Fix

Replace `-> expr` with `{ expr }`; `jet fmt` applies this fix.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0080: tests/ui/inline_module_return_type_mismatch.stderr.

Error [jet.ArrowFunctionBody]: A braced callable with a non-unit success result needs `->` before its body.
  --> tests/ui/inline_module_return_type_mismatch.jet:15:23
    |
 15 | fn bad() bank.Account {
    |                       ^
 Why: The body arrow marks a declared success value; unit and unit-fallible callables keep bare braces.
 Fix: Write `fn name(...) Type -> { ... }`; keep `fn name(...) { ... }` bare for a unit result.
